page.notes: The text is set in one paragraph running over from the previous page, so cont="true" is used. The dagger mark (†) beside the catchword is not transcribed as text. Faint marks in the left margin are show-through or scan dirt and are not transcribed. Spellings were normalised for long s and u/v/i/j as instructed. Italic type is shown with <i> for "Jer.", "Judaei in captivitatem abduci a Chal-daeis", and "Jehovam". The printed hyphens in "decerne-re", "sequi-tur", "su-pernaturalium" and "Chal-daeis" are kept at the line ends. The word "horumomnium" is printed without a space and is left as printed. The printed "1.Quare?" is written as "1. Quare?" for readability, and "fore ?" is written as "fore?".
